suncrest_ops: Hi team — Suncrest Insurance here. We'd like to onboard a custom ONNX-quantized reranker for auto-claims triage. Model will process PHI so we need Private deployment + HSM for keys. What's the intake process and timeline? Our SRE contact is derek.suncrest.

emily_cs: Thanks — this sounds like Private + HSM is likely. Can you share the model artifact (onnx opset, SHA), a small eval set, and expected QPS/latency SLOs? Also any compliance requirements (BAA/HIPAA). Link to onboarding doc: https://redwood-internal/onboard-guide

suncrest_ops: Opset: 12. Quantized int8 via onnxruntime-quant. Artifact size ~4.2GB, sha256: abcd1234ef... Peak ~30 rps, ~500k tokens/month. Latency target p95 <120ms. We require SOC2 + HIPAA flow and BAA. Uploading sample payload now: ```{
  "input_ids": [101, 2054, ...],
  "attention_mask": [1,1,1,...],
  "metadata": {"claim_id": "C12345"}
}```

raj_engineer: Opset 12 is fine generally but custom ops can be a problem. We'll run the ONNX compatibility test. Can you provide the .onnx via secure upload (pre-signed S3 or secure link) and a ~1k example eval set with labels? Also include model signature (input names / shapes) and quantization calibration table if you used per-channel calibration.

leah_sre: For Private + HSM we'll need your network diagram, VPC peering requirements, and KMS/HSM vendor + key lifecycle info. Also confirm requested retention for logs and audit trails. Note: our ONNX runtime build supports int8 on CUDA but some kernels need special builds — I'll validate once we have the artifact.

emily_cs: I'll schedule a 30m intake tomorrow at 10:30am PT to walk through requirements and next steps. Derek, can you confirm availability? I'll open the onboarding ticket and loop in legal for the BAA.

suncrest_ops: Confirmed — derek.suncrest will join at 10:30 PT. Uploading the artifact and eval set to secure link now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

raj_engineer: Quick note — if quantization used per-channel scales please include the calibration table and any custom operators. Example expected signature: `input_ids:int32[1,max_len]`, `attention_mask:int8[1,max_len]`, output `scores:float[1,num_candidates]`.

emily_cs: Created ticket CS-4321 and added checklist items (compat test, privacy review, infra run). Link: https://redwood-internal/tickets/CS-4321. I'll post meeting invite. :calendar:

audit-bot: Artifact upload detected: suncrest_auto_claims_v2.onnx (sha256:abcd1234ef567890...). Secure upload URL expires in 72h.

leah_sre: :eyes: I'll kick off a compatibility bench today and paste results into CS-4321. If we see custom ops we'll propose a small shim or request a fallback build.

emily_cs: Thanks team — we'll aim to have an initial compatibility report within 48h and a private deployment ETA after infra signoff. Suncrest, we'll follow up in the meeting with concrete next steps and dates.
